question: Should ClawHub preserve unique `SKILL.md`, `skill.md`, and legacy `skills.md` aliases while rejecting case-colliding variants, and should `PROTOCOL.md` receive the same special package rule?
rationale: The portability defect and implementation shape are concrete, but uppercase-only enforcement would be a compatibility break and current main does not establish `PROTOCOL.md` as metadata.

options.title: Preserve aliases, reject collisions
options.body: Keep current unique skill metadata aliases, reject their case-colliding variants across every ingestion surface, and include `PROTOCOL.md` only if its contract is intentional.

options.title: Require uppercase metadata
options.body: Adopt uppercase-only names through a documented migration, corpus cleanup, compatibility tests, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split protocol policy
options.body: Land skill metadata collision rejection now and decide `PROTOCOL.md` naming semantics separately.

recommendation.title: Preserve aliases, reject collisions
recommendation.body: Keep current unique skill metadata aliases, reject their case-colliding variants across every ingestion surface, and include `PROTOCOL.md` only if its contract is intentional.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main provenance connects this contributor to both central package ingestion contracts.
